strategy_roster.name: Random State Machine
strategy_roster.notes: Moving-average reference translated with inferred/default periods 10/30; unsupported shifts, recursive state, or execution rules are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Currency Strength v1.1
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using current-period ATR relative to its rolling average; absolute price-step risk controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Fractal Weight Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is expressed from the rolling high/low range using the DSL primitives; vendor-specific smoothing/state is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: MOC Delta MOO Entry
strategy_roster.notes: Moving-average reference translated with inferred/default periods 10/30; unsupported shifts, recursive state, or execution rules are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Starter V6 Mod Strategy (StockSharp Conversion)
strategy_roster.notes: Reference strategy is not expressible as a deterministic single-security OHLCV entry signal in the TASI DSL; a never-true guard is used rather than fabricating a signal. Unsupported schedule, portfolio, order-management, external-data, or multi-order mechanics are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Mean Reversion with Incremental Entry
strategy_roster.notes: Moving-average trend rule translated with inferred/default period 30.

strategy_roster.name: Baseline2
strategy_roster.notes: ADX/trend reference translated to an OHLCV-compatible trend filter; unsupported directional-index/state logic is simplified.

strategy_roster.name: VWMA Cross
strategy_roster.notes: VWAP/VWMA is approximated with a volume-confirmed moving-average trend filter because anchored/session VWAP is unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Dynamic Averaging
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic is approximated from the close position within the 14-bar high/low range because the DSL has no dedicated stochastic function.

strategy_roster.name: Quantitative Trend Strategy Uptrend Long
strategy_roster.notes: Fractal/pivot/zigzag structure is approximated with prior-bar Donchian extremes because explicit pivot state is unavailable in the DSL.
